page: Vultr voc-m-24c-192gb-2400s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server powered by an AMD EPYC processor with 24 dedicated vCPUs, consisting of 12 physical cores with hyper-threading, running at 2.0 GHz. The system features 192.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core, and includes 2400 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The x86_64 architecture supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, including VNNI and BF16, alongside cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI.

Benchmark results indicate strong capabilities across multiple domains. The server achieves top-tier performance in single-core stress-ng tests and PassMark memory scores. Multi-core performance, including Geekbench multi-core and PassMark CPU tests, ranks in the top 25%. Large-block memory bandwidth reads and writes are also strong, while database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput register in the average range. For machine learning workloads, the server demonstrates top-tier text generation speeds for small LLM models and strong text generation for medium-sized models.

This server offers high resource density, balancing a substantial memory footprint with dedicated compute resources and fast local NVMe storage. The 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it highly cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not require GPU acceleration. It is well-suited for memory-optimized databases, large-scale data processing, software compilation, and text-based machine learning inference.
